description: Check if a domain name is valid and available before creating it. Returns the normalized form and availability.

domain.description: Domain name to check (e.g. "www.example.com"). Call before domains_set to check availability.

name: domains_validate

available.description: Whether nobody has registered the name yet; null when invalid. Creating it would be new; re-pointing your own domain is a write, not a create.

normalized.description: The normalized domain name; null when invalid.

reason.description: Why the name is unusable, for display; null when it is usable.

valid.description: Whether the domain's shape is usable.

title: Check Domain Availability
